🚨 mosquito, Extended Warranty, Big Big is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Extended Warranty is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.

🔥 The fire settles. Owen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Valeria says "The fire feels smaller now." Ivy says quietly "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
